descriptions.text: A journalist facing the consequences of a libel conviction accepts an unusual investigation into a wealthy Swedish family. Harriet Vanger disappeared decades earlier, but her uncle has never stopped searching for an explanation. Mikael Blomkvist works with Lisbeth Salander, a researcher and hacker whose abilities challenge his assumptions. Their inquiries bring the family's public standing into conflict with a much darker history. The disappearance becomes a way into questions of violence, secrecy and power.
